description: This file implements an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache data structure used as part of the typeahead.js library. It defines the LruCache class with methods to set, get, reset, and manage cache entries, including internal classes List and Node to handle the linked list structure for cache eviction policy.

classes.name: LruCache
classes.description: A cache that stores a limited number of key-value pairs, evicting least recently used items when capacity is exceeded.

classes.name: List
classes.description: A doubly linked list used internally within the LruCache for managing cache order.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A node representing each cache entry with pointers to previous and next nodes.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds or updates a cache entry with a specified key and value. Evicts least recently used item if at capacity.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, moving the accessed node to the front of the cache.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the cache, resetting its size and internal data structures.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a node to the front of the linked list.

methods.name: remove(node)
methods.description: Removes a node from the linked list.

methods.name: moveToFront
methods.description: Moves a given node to the front of the list, indicating recent access.
